mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(assign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM class_assign WHERE assign_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY date

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_assign_task_count, SUM(IF(status = #{assigned}, 1, 0)) AS assigned_count, SUM(IF(status = #{unassigned}, 1, 0)) AS unassigned_count, SUM(IF(status = #{assigned}, student_num, 0)) AS total_assigned_student_count FROM class_assign WHERE deleted=0
AND assign_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
